北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴朗，体感 1℃。记得多穿衣，别着凉哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny, feels like 1℃. Remember to dress warmly and don't catch a cold!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪大雾，体感 5℃。出行请注意交通安全，保暖防着凉。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is foggy, feels like 5℃. Drive safely and keep warm!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海有雾，体感 8℃。能见度低，外出多注意安全哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is foggy, feels like 8℃. Low visibility, please stay safe outdoors.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光正好，体感 26℃。多享受户外美好时光吧！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and warm, feels like 26℃. Enjoy the beautiful outdoors!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，体感 24℃。天气舒适，户外活动很不错。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy and pleasant, feels like 24℃. A great day for outdoor activities.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州小雨，体感 5℃。雨天湿滑，出门记得带伞和保暖！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has light rain, feels like 5℃. It's slippery, bring an umbrella and stay warm!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京大雾，体感 3℃。能见度低，出行请注意安全哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is foggy, feels like 3℃. Low visibility, please travel safely.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 9℃。气温适中，保持好心情哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and mild, feels like 9℃. Keep a good mood!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有雾，体感 4℃。能见度低，注意出行安全哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy, feels like 4℃. Low visibility, please travel safely.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，体感 2℃。天气干燥，记得多喝水，注意保暖！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and chilly, feels like 2℃. It's dry, hydrate well and stay warm!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 8℃。气温微凉，出门别忘了添衣。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and cool, feels like 8℃. Remember to dress warmly.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗，体感 -18℃！户外记得全副武装，别冻着！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny but extremely cold, feels like -18℃! Bundle up well outdoors!
哈尔滨.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -18℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云，体感 -9℃。气温很低，出门要裹严实点哦！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy and very cold, feels like -9℃. Bundle up tightly when going out!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，体感 9℃。天气温和，可以出去走走。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and mild, feels like 9℃. You can go for a walk.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，体感 20℃。天气宜人，适合户外走走哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy and pleasant, feels like 20℃. Perfect for a walk outdoors.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛晴朗，体感 1℃。风力不小，多添衣物，注意保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is sunny but chilly, feels like 1℃. It's windy, dress warmly!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴朗但寒冷，体感 -5℃。风大，注意保暖防风哦！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny but cold, feels like -5℃. It's windy, stay warm and sheltered from wind!
